scope: Offline operational evaluator only; separate from frozen primary fixed-grid protocol
representative_selection: Exactly the instance already fixed before Subphases 6/7 operational evaluation; no selection by new campaign outcomes
full_run_launch: Not authorized until frozen method, representative verification and execution plan are reviewed by user
alternative_worlds: Never merge variant streams, graphs, indicators or repeated User IDs across independent branches. Family and seed remain explicit in denominators.
declared_interval: Reuse campaign_register_v2.csv campaign_start and campaign_end_exclusive; require equality with frozen replay anchor/end_exclusive. No extending accepted observations or dropping final ten minutes.
onset: Earliest is_synthetic=true AND credential_stuffing_label=1 event belonging to this campaign across its declared targeted organizations. Per-org first evidence and per-User first evidence are recorded separately. No positive evidence means not exposed/not evaluable, not an undetected campaign.
observation_horizon: [actual global campaign onset, declared campaign_end_exclusive). End is fixed by the frozen dataset, not by detector results. Duration may be less than the declared one-hour branch because first targeting can occur after branch start. No post-end follow-up is invented.
target_user_denominator: Unique organization-local Users with at least one matching positive synthetic targeting event inside the declared campaign interval. Check against frozen per-branch targeted_users census. No cross-org or cross-variant User deduplication; no credential matching.
qualifying_alert: A stored original local-only ALERT or separately stored local-plus-indicator ALERT for the same local User and branch, within this campaign's observed horizon, with at least one campaign-specific positive event in (alert_time-600 seconds, alert_time]. Exact onset equality is allowed; evidence exactly ten minutes old and alerts at exclusive campaign end do not qualify.
attribution_ambiguity: Compute all eligible recent campaign candidates for each alert. Exactly one candidate gets primary credit. Multiple candidates are logged ambiguous and none receives primary credit; do not double-credit or choose by volume/score/future outcome. Zero candidates is unattributed, not automatically a verified false positive. Overlapping windows with different Users or different branch/org keys remain independent.
background_and_false_alerts: Alerts before actual onset, on unrelated/non-targeted Users, without recent matching targeting evidence or after horizon do not count. A uniquely associated alert during real targeting is operational temporal association, not proof the model responded causally to the injected attempts rather than background behavior.
delayed_alerts: After the last campaign attempt an alert may qualify only while matching evidence remains younger than ten minutes and before declared end. Later alerts are excluded; no finite detection time is assigned to missing alerts.
organization_detection: At least one uniquely attributable qualifying alert on at least one exposed local targeted User. Report User-time rows, raw alerts, qualifying alert rows, unique exposed target Users and unique detected target Users separately.
campaign_detection: ANY targeted organization detected. Also report ALL targeted organizations detected and partially detected campaigns separately.
primary_undetected_campaign: Every declared targeted organization has complete accepted observation coverage and positive exposure, and NONE has any uniquely attributable qualifying alert. Do not confuse failure in one organization with campaign-wide non-detection.
coverage: Verify frozen full-hour observation counts, final end-minus-one-microsecond flush and final-ten-minute counts against accepted manifests. Missing/incomplete organizations are pending or incomplete, never undetected. Primary campaign denominators require all targeted organizations complete; non-targeted organizations are excluded from detection denominators.
censoring: No qualifying alert: event_time_seconds=null, right_censored=true, censor_time_seconds=observed_end-global_onset. Complete observation can be undetected within the defined horizon while still right-censored for later detection. Incomplete observation is not a primary complete-horizon non-detection. Record incomplete/no-exposure separately.
time_origins: Primary first-detection delay is from global actual onset. Record local-exposure delay separately. Unique-target-User delay is from that User's first matching positive event. Microsecond naive source timestamps; no timezone conversion.
units: Operational scored User-time, unique exposed targeted Users, targeted organization-campaign trials and campaign instances are different units. Additional event-only NOT_SCORED rows, if any, are separate and excluded from primary paired rows.
aggregation: Per organization and per campaign, plus descriptive counts/fractions grouped by family, RIP_target, Raccount_target, Sorg_target and seed, with evaluated/required/pending denominators. Missing branches are not zero detections. No naive IID confidence intervals over dependent alternative branches or User rows.
runtime_boundary: Campaign IDs, synthetic flags, labels and target-account mapping are decoded only after local and indicator decisions are sealed. They never enter inference, features, target selection, IP attribution or distribution. Preserve original local GraphSAGE weights, thresholds, source policy and input hashes.
calibration_boundary: The 1% target remains the accepted eligible fixed-grid clean-negative User-time calibration. Campaign detection fractions and operational alert counts are not FPR, and this protocol neither replaces the primary unit nor recalibrates any threshold.
optimizations: Only exact-equivalent accepted computation reuse is allowed. Preserve unrounded score/threshold encodings, model/schema/protocol identity, local and combined alerts, temporal logs, graph lineage and campaign attribution. Proposals without full equivalence remain unvalidated and disabled.
completion: Subphase 8 stays IN_PROGRESS until all 171 VAL instances have complete validated results for both families. Pilot success is not a subphase acceptance pass. No TEST, retraining, calibration, federation, DP, robust aggregation, Fabric or Subphase 9.
